# agentic-platform-engineering-extravaganza

> 42→0: a real policy gate (OPA/Conftest) takes an AI agent's Kubernetes manifests from 42 violations to zero. Golden paths, Crossplane, an authz-gated MCP server.

agentic-platform-engineering-extravaganza is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).
